articles.title: Moving Beyond Static Cookie Banners: Implementing Zero-Leakage Real-Time Consent Management
articles.summary:
A cookie banner is a user interface requirement, not a control. Many sites display a cookie consent banner giving you options to opt-in or opt-out while the tag manager has already loaded analytics, advertising pixels and session replay, so personal data reaches third parties before the visitor makes any choice and this has caused pre-settlement […]

articles.title: Hackers Hide Password-Stealing Malware in GitHub Code, Putting Software Downloads at Risk
articles.summary:
Hackers slipped password-stealing malware into open GitHub pull requests at AsyncAPI Generator, CircuitVerse and Open Food Facts. At CircuitVerse, the code ran in the automated release workflow that built desktop software for Windows, Linux and macOS. articles.title: Bithumb Hacked for 15 Days, Customer Passport Numbers, Bank Details and Wallet Addresses Stolen
articles.summary:
South Korean cryptocurrency exchange Bithumb says hackers stole passport numbers, bank account numbers, and crypto wallet addresses after gaining access to an internal system for more than 15 days. In a November 25 update, the company said its investigation found more people and more types of personal data were affected than it had reported on […]

articles.summary:

articles.title: Standard Chartered’s Zodia Custody Hacked, Client and Employee Data Exposed
articles.summary:

articles.title: OpenAI AI Agents Bypass Security Restrictions and Access Government Systems Without Permission
articles.summary:

articles.title: Microsoft Confirms Windows November Updates Can Break SSO and Third-Party App Logins
articles.summary:
Microsoft has confirmed that the November 2026 Windows security updates can cause sign-in failures in some third-party apps and devices that use NTLM authentication. The issue can affect authentication proxies, single sign-on (SSO) tools, and application packaging products after teams install the November 10 security update or a later update that includes the same changes. articles.title: Drupal Warns of Active Attacks Exploiting New Critical Website Takeover Vulnerability
articles.summary:
Drupal has warned that attackers are actively exploiting CVE-2026-136716, a highly critical access bypass that can let them take over vulnerable websites without signing in.
